Name: (CP) Improved Cindersap Forest - Now With Fifty Percent More Forest
Author: LilietBorodina
Description:
It has bugged me for a long time that Cindersap Forest doesn't really... look or feel like a forest. Especially when you're playing on a Forest Map, that has the lovely dense foliage... while the supposed "forest" to the south of it doesn't? Well, and I went and did something about it!

- The map is [b]fully passable[/b] everywhere except for the Secret Woods entrance even without any tools (although to get to the hat shop without tools you'll have to go over the river bridges).

- All dense forest patches are passable with a [b]scythe[/b]. They can be a bit labyrinthine inside though ;)

- It's recommended to start a new save with it, but it's [b]usable on an existing save[/b], too. To reset bushes, either:
1) install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2269]Entoarox Framework[/url], load your save and type "world_reset bushes" (without the quotes) into the SMAPI console. Entoarox apparently uses depreciated SMAPI code and will break on SMAPI 4.0 unless it's updated by then, but for now it works! The correct bushes will appear the next day (you need to save to see the result, of course), trees will take time to grow.
2) install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9350]Reset Terrain Features[/url] (or [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-64#post-43678]its unofficial update[/url]), load your save and, apparently, press L. I haven't tried this one, but I have it on good authority that it works, too!

- I also recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304]Destroyable Bushes[/url], which allows you to break bushes with an axe and have them regrow later. My mod is fully usable without it, however ^^

- Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3418]Erin's Festival Map Edit[/url] ﻿by erinyang via duplication of features, so you can get edited festival maps for the Ice Festival without downloading erinyang's mod - [b]full credit to them for the idea and the design of implementation[/b]. To get the edited maps, find "Improved Cindersap Forest" in the Mod Config Menu and select the version you'd like - "Default" (wizard inaccessible), "Map edit" (wizard in the vanilla location, but made accessible) or "NPC relocate" (wizard relocated to an accessible place). Or if you're playing without Mod Config Menu for some reason (???) edit those in the config file in the mod's folder.

- Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14635]Cape Stardew[/url], and in fact I recommend it! There's a lot more forest space with that mod ^^

- Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14510]Ornithologist's Guild!
[/url]
- Compatible with [url=https://ko-fi.com/s/f5b179e3f1]Overgrown Valley[/url]!

- Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14677?tab=description]Irina is my favorite character[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6626]Lunna - Astray in Stardew Valley[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7002?tab=description]Custom NPC Eugene[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8606]Juna - Roommate NPC[/url]. Irina is not natively compatible with the other two, but you can download the patch I made (it needs to be copypasted into the pre-existing Irina mod folder, not just dropped into the /Mods folder!) and it will be. Fair warning, Irina also breaks recolor mods by forcing vanilla palettes on terrain instead. I've commented on it pointing out this issue, the ball is in Buntovskikh Danil's court now.

- Might be compatible with other mods that edit the forest's eastern and southern edges, but if there's overlap with what my mod edits, one or the other will win and the result will probably look ugly. If there are specific mods you'd like to be made compatible like I did for Cape Stardew, tell me!

- Now has a compatibility mode for mods that edit the fence in the north in between the wandering trader and Secret Woods. Confirmed compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30445]Ranger Taro[/url], let me know if any other specific one has a problem.

- [b][size=5]NOW SVE COMPATIBLE!!!!![/size][/b] Everyone say thank you to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/bluetrait]bluetrait[/url]

[b]Mods showcased in the screenshots:[/b] Seasonal Villager Outfits by paradigmnomad, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8107]Flower Dancing - A Flower Dance Mod[/url]﻿ by kelly2892, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2072]Dynamic Night Time[/url] by KNakamura, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7332]Way Back Pelican Town[/url] by Gweniaczek, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url] by grapeponta, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4966]Stardew Foliage Redone: Foliage Only[/url] by Hesper, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14649]Yri's Modular Tree Recolor[/url] by Yri, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25720]Bog's Witchy Foliage[/url] by BogWyytch, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6733]Seaside Valley[/url] by risrain.

Downloads.Description:
To install this patch, unzip it, open the Irina mod folder (you should see "Irina-EN") and paste this patch's contents (also "Irina-EN") into it. It should ask you if you want to replace 1 file (content.json). Do that.
This is a patch for version 1.0.4.
